title: G01 Consignment Animal Identification
description: Official identification linkage, issued once per consignment. Content follows the identification regime of the species: official identifiers (or a commitment to them) for individually identified species; holding mark, batch reference, headcount and weight for batch-identified species.

x-traced.status: pre-project draft — subject to change in T4.1
x-traced.issuer: Competent authority, as operator of the national identification and registration database (authentic source) — e.g. the Italian national database (BDN) run by IZS Teramo for the Ministry of Health.
x-traced.holder: Transporter for the journey (legal-entity wallet); presentable by the keeper at departure and destination.
verifiers: Competent authority of the place of departure
Keeper and competent authority at destination
legalBasis: Delegated Reg (EU) 2019/2035 (identification and traceability of kept terrestrial animals)
x-traced.forwardCompatibility: Unchanged by COM(2023) 770; identification rules sit in the Animal Health Law.
x-traced.revocation: Superseded if the consignment changes before departure.
x-traced.integrity: Issuer electronic seal; source records remain in the national database.
useCases: UC-3 official verification at control points
openQuestions: Commitment scheme for individual identifiers (salted Merkle tree vs. per-identifier SD-JWT disclosures).

consignmentId.description: Consignment identifier, bound to the I01 journey anchor.

identificationRegime.description: individual or batch identification, per species rules.

headcount.description: Number of animals in the consignment.

individualIdentifiers.description: Official identifiers of each animal (individual regime).

identifiersCommitment.description: Cryptographic commitment (e.g. Merkle root) to the individual identifiers, with disclosure on demand — alternative to listing them.

sourceDatabase.description: Authentic source: the national identification and registration database.

extractedAt.description: Time the consignment data was drawn from the source database.
